vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit word परिशत् (parishat), meaning 'army, retinue', which can also be interpreted as 'those who are near (to the king) and obey his commands'. The name Paresh can thus be seen as a reflection of the power and authority of a king or ruler.

data.cultural_impact: The name Paresh carries deep cultural significance in Hinduism. This name is rooted in the belief that there is a supreme being who rules over all creation. This reverence for the divine is reflected in the naming tradition, where a child is given a name that reflects this belief. The use of the term 'Lord of all beings' underscores the importance of devotion, reverence, and respect for the divine in Hindu culture.

The name is believed to bestow blessings of divine protection, strength, and wisdom upon the bearer. It is a name that inspires one to connect with the divine and to live a life that is in harmony with the supreme consciousness. The spiritual significance of the name Paresh is a powerful reminder of the interconnectedness of all beings and the ultimate reality of the divine.
